candidate_relations.reason: The UCG did show heart valve degeneration with aortic, mitral, and tricuspid regurgitation, so valvular heart disease is a component finding in this case. However, the benchmark reference is specifically 'Chemotherapy-induced sinus arrhythmia with cardiotoxicity,' which centers on the chemotherapy etiology and the arrhythmic/cardiotoxic manifestation. C001 captures only one structural finding without the defining etiology or the primary arrhythmia diagnosis, making it an incomplete component rather than the full diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the valvular findings (degeneration with regurgitation) seen on UCG but omits the chemotherapy-induced etiology, the sinus arrhythmia/cardiotoxicity diagnosis, and the arrhythmic presentation that defines the benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis combines two components (sinus arrhythmia and cardiotoxicity) under a chemotherapy-induced etiology; the dynamic ECG finding of 'short-array chamber tachycardia' may represent supraventricular tachycardia rather than pure sinus arrhythmia, introducing minor diagnostic ambiguity
Electrolyte results mentioned as evaluated but values not reported; hypokalemia or other electrolyte disturbances as contributing causes cannot be excluded
